h: Senate Chief Whip Monguno and APC leaders reportedly escape Boko Haram attack in Borno
p: Senate Chief Whip Mohammed Tahir Monguno reportedly escaped a Boko Haram attack during a campaign tour of Kukawa, Borno State. Troops are said to have moved quickly to repel the attackers.
body: Senate Chief Whip Mohammed Tahir Monguno, who represents Borno North, has reportedly escaped a Boko Haram attack during a 2027 campaign tour of Kukawa Local Government Area of Borno State on Tuesday, 17 November 2026.

Monguno is said to have travelled to Kukawa with former governor and senator Maina Maaji Lawan and other APC figures to campaign when the insurgents tried to overrun the area. Troops of Operation Hadin Kai, acting on intelligence, reportedly moved quickly to repel the attackers.

The APC entourage had earlier gathered in Monguno town on Sunday, where the senator joined Governor Babagana Zulum for the launch of the party's campaign in the area. The governor returned to Maiduguri by helicopter on Monday, while Monguno and others continued to Kukawa.
more: The attack happened in Kukawa, Borno State.
The senator was on a 2027 campaign tour.
